(Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate III, Vaishali at Hajipur in Complaint Case No 64 of 2020 subject to the conditions as laid down in Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
